fixture.repository: one temporary repository, one file, linear history
fixture.isolation: own HOME and GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL; no network

methodology.statistic: median across runs, with the observed range in each note
methodology.caveat: A short repeated run on one machine, not a soak test. Every measurement names the processes it covers; nothing here is a 24-hour figure or a claim about other hardware.

measurements.name: cold-start-to-ready
measurements.processScope: refyard CLI process: spawn → listener up → readiness object printed (Git feature probe included)
measurements.notes: Includes the doctor-style Git feature probe at startup; excludes building the fixture. median of 3 runs, range 0.455–0.458.

measurements.name: service-rss-after-start
measurements.processScope: the refyard service process only (ps -o rss), after readiness and before any read
measurements.memoryMetric: resident set size of that process, as reported by ps
measurements.notes: Excludes the browser and excludes any Git process. median of 3 runs, range 86.016–86.047.

measurements.name: status-read-throughput
measurements.processScope: one refyard service process over loopback HTTP; each read runs `git status --porcelain=v2 --branch -z` plus the index read
measurements.notes: At concurrency 4 against a 100000-commit repository on this machine. median of 3 runs, range 178.891–188.679.

measurements.name: service-rss-after-reads
measurements.processScope: the refyard service process only, after the read batch above
measurements.memoryMetric: resident set size of that process, as reported by ps
measurements.notes: After 100 reads at concurrency 4. median of 3 runs, range 93.844–93.938.

measurements.name: history-first-page
measurements.processScope: one refyard service process; `git log` for one page plus the graph fold
measurements.notes: Page size 100 of 100000 commits; the response is bounded by the contract's page limit (truncated in 3 of 3 runs). median of 3 runs, range 387–390.

measurements.name: graceful-shutdown
measurements.processScope: the refyard service process, SIGTERM → exit (no in-flight requests)
measurements.notes: The bounded drain window applies only when a request is in flight. median of 3 runs, range 4–4.
